name: Purandar airport
title: Purandar airport: status and timeline
summary: Pune's planned second airport at Purandar, south-east of the city, separate from the airport at Lohegaon.
means: A new airport is years away: it does not change travel times from any area we cover today. Treat a flat ad that sells it as nearby as a claim to check.

history.status: The Bombay High Court dismissed the farmers' plea against the chosen site, so land acquisition can go on.
The district administration says it has possession of 76% of the land; holdouts were given until 10 October to consent.
The remaining 40 hectares, where farmers did not consent, is to be taken by compulsory acquisition.
Land acquisition is nearly done: the remaining 40 hectares is being taken compulsorily, and MADC has started appointing a consultant for the feasibility study and project report.
